config.label: oauth or service_account
config.description: oauth or service_account. Unset defaults to service_account. Set oauth for Quick Connect or your own OAuth client.

config.label: readonly or full
config.description: readonly or full. full enables gsc_submit_url, gsc_submit_batch, and gsc_submit_sitemap. When unset, legacy GSC_SCOPES and GSC_ENABLE_WRITE apply and writes stay off unless both allow them. Setup refuses full access for Quick Connect.

config.label: Property allowlist
config.description: Property allowlist. JSON string array of exact Search Console property ids, a legacy comma-separated list, or all alone (or JSON ["all"]) for every current and future property. Property-scoped tools need an allowlist.

config.label: Path to a service account JSON key
config.description: Path to a service account JSON key. Required when GSC_AUTH_MODE is service_account, which is the default mode.

config.label: Local state directory for OAuth tokens, datasets and opt-in audit history
config.description: Local state directory for OAuth tokens, datasets and opt-in audit history. Default is ~/.gsc-mcp.

config.label: Set to 1 to allow gsc_export_dataset and saved gsc_generate_report files on this machine
config.description: Set to 1 to allow gsc_export_dataset and saved gsc_generate_report files on this machine. Any other value keeps local export disabled.

config.label: Set to 1 for explicit local gsc_change_impact history actions
config.description: Set to 1 for explicit local gsc_change_impact history actions. Independent of exports; no scheduler or notifications.

config.label: Optional path to a Desktop OAuth client secrets JSON file
config.description: Optional path to a Desktop OAuth client secrets JSON file. It takes precedence over GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET. Quick Connect does not need it.

config.label: Optional OAuth client id
config.description: Optional OAuth client id. Used with GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET when GSC_OAUTH_SECRETS_FILE is unset. Quick Connect does not need it.

config.label: Optional OAuth client secret paired with GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
config.description: Optional OAuth client secret paired with GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID. Quick Connect does not need it.

config.label: Legacy scope tier, readonly or full
config.description: Legacy scope tier, readonly or full. Ignored when GSC_ACCESS_MODE is set. full alone does not enable writes.

config.label: Legacy write opt-in
config.description: Legacy write opt-in. Set to 1 together with GSC_SCOPES=full when GSC_ACCESS_MODE is unset. Ignored when GSC_ACCESS_MODE is set.
